categories.main_business_segments: Jafron Biomedical Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of biomedical materials and high-tech medical devices, focusing on blood purification products. Its main product lines include disposable hemoperfusion cartridges, plasma bilirubin adsorption columns, DNA immune adsorption columns, cytokine adsorption columns, dialysis concentrates, and blood purification equipment. These products are applied in treating uremia, poisoning, severe liver diseases, autoimmune diseases, and multiple organ failure. The company also operates in pharmaceutical production through its subsidiary and engages in health management and insurance brokerage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in adsorption material production, including carrier preparation, coating technology, ligand preparation and grafting, and medical-grade purification processes. It employs advanced automated and intelligent manufacturing techniques, such as magnetic levitation conveyor lines and AI+ visual inspection, to ensure high product quality and efficiency. The production strictly follows over 300 process documents and nearly 200 quality control files, complying with national Class III medical device standards and international certifications like CE and ISO.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jafron serves primarily hospitals and medical institutions across nephrology, hepatology, critical care, and immunology departments. Its products target patients with chronic kidney disease, end-stage renal disease, liver failure, sepsis, acute poisoning, and autoimmune diseases. The company’s customer base includes over 6,000 hospitals domestically and extends internationally to 92 countries. It also collaborates with over 80 large hospitals for clinical research and academic promotion.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with extensive coverage across provinces and hospitals nationwide. It has expanded its international presence to 92 countries including Germany, Switzerland, the UK, Italy, Spain, India, Russia, Mexico, and Brazil. It has established marketing and academic promotion networks domestically and participates in global academic forums to enhance international influence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jafron operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the blood purification medical device supply chain. It controls core raw material synthesis (HA resin) through proprietary formulas and supervises suppliers, ensuring quality and exclusivity. The company manufactures finished medical devices and equipment, conducts R&D, and sells products mainly through a buyout distributor model to hospitals, supported by its own academic promotion and service teams.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in blood purification technologies, focusing on carrier preparation, ligand modification, grafting, and biocompatibility testing platforms. It invests heavily in R&D (12.76% of revenue in 2023) to develop new products addressing inflammation mediators, immune factors, bilirubin, endotoxins, lipid-lowering, and extracorporeal circulation devices. It leverages national technology centers, academic collaborations, and clinical research to maintain technological leadership and expand product lines for chronic and critical diseases.
categories.revenue_model: Jafron generates revenue primarily through the sale of disposable blood purification consumables and medical devices, including hemoperfusion cartridges, adsorption columns, dialysis concentrates, and blood purification equipment. Sales are conducted mainly via buyout distributors to hospitals, supplemented by direct sales and academic promotion services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns, with a small portion from pharmaceutical products through its subsidiary.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jafron holds a leading position in the emerging blood purification medical device industry in China, recognized as a national manufacturing champion and technology innovator. The domestic market has limited competitors with smaller scale, giving Jafron a dominant market share. The company faces increasing competition as the industry grows but maintains advantages through proprietary technology, extensive clinical validation, and comprehensive academic promotion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Jafron reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.92 billion, a 22.84% decline year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 436 million, down 50.93%. The company experienced short-term challenges due to market demand contraction, policy adjustments, and internal restructuring. However, cash flow from operations remained strong at RMB 917 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 5.54 billion with a net asset return of 13.09%. Early 2024 showed recovery with Q1 revenue growth of 30% and net profit growth of 44.9%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jafron emphasizes its unique value through proprietary core technologies in adsorption materials and medical-grade purification, ensuring high safety and efficacy. Its product portfolio covers comprehensive clinical needs across nephrology, hepatology, critical care, and immunology with tailored solutions for different patient groups. The company’s strong academic promotion and clinical research collaborations enhance product acceptance and market penetration. Its advanced automated manufacturing and strict quality control systems further differentiate its products in terms of reliability and performance.
